assessment.title: Chemistry Lab Safety Assessment
assessment.subject: Chemistry
assessment.description: Assessment on laboratory safety protocols and chemical handling

studentResponse: {"rawAnswer":{"explanationQuestion":"Lab safety is crucial in chemistry because chemicals can be dangerous if not handled properly. I always wear safety goggles to protect my eyes from chemical splashes, use gloves when handling corrosive substances, and make sure to work in a well-ventilated area. I also know to never taste or smell chemicals directly, and to always read the safety data sheet before using any chemical.","observationQuestion":"During the lab demonstration, I observed that the teacher always wore proper PPE including goggles, lab coat, and gloves. They also showed us how to properly dispose of chemicals and clean up spills. The fume hood was used when working with volatile substances, which I found very important for safety."}}
